summary: Prediction, not yet built: handling the market-open burst and making cost visible. A queue absorbs the order spike so the saga processes it at a sustainable rate.

nodes.label: Reader
nodes.purpose: A blog reader exploring Bullpen's architecture timeline on the landing site.

nodes.label: Player
nodes.purpose: A registered player who places paper trade orders, including at market open.

nodes.label: Bullpen Landing
nodes.purpose: The public landing site with the architecture timeline explorer.

nodes.label: Bullpen Trading App
nodes.purpose: The trading app where players view prices and history and submit paper trade orders.

nodes.label: Prices Service
nodes.purpose: Owns live price snapshots, consulted by the order saga at fill time.

nodes.label: Prices Database
nodes.purpose: Neon Postgres database owned solely by the Prices Service.

nodes.label: Market History Service
nodes.purpose: Serves historical price/candle queries independently of live snapshots, with its own write path and own database.

nodes.label: Market History Database
nodes.purpose: Neon Postgres database owned solely by the Market History Service.

nodes.label: Orders Service
nodes.purpose: Accepts paper trade order requests and publishes them onto the market-open queue instead of starting the saga directly.

nodes.label: Market Open Queue
nodes.purpose: Buffers the burst of order requests at market open (Vercel Queues or equivalent) so the Order Saga consumes them at a sustainable rate rather than falling over.

nodes.label: Order Saga
nodes.purpose: Durable workflow orchestrating each queued order: price lookup, balance check, fill, and ledger update.

nodes.label: Ledger Service
nodes.purpose: Owns player balances and positions as an independent data boundary.

nodes.label: Market Data Provider
nodes.purpose: External market-data API. Provider still TBD pending a terms-of-use-compliant choice.

steps.caption: Submit
steps.detail: Player submits a paper trade order from the ticket.

steps.caption: Queue it
steps.detail: Orders Service publishes the request onto the market-open queue instead of starting the saga directly.

steps.caption: Consume
steps.detail: The Order Saga picks up queued orders at a sustainable rate.

steps.caption: Price
steps.detail: The saga asks the Prices Service for the current price.

steps.caption: Reserve, fill and settle
steps.detail: The saga updates balances and positions through the Ledger Service.
